title: Peer artifact acceptance and consumer-route evidence boundary
mode: Primary-source application, writer-policy, peer-claim, and local-harness audit
scope: Trace FreeCAD's current DWG converter helper and distinguish converter output creation from downstream DXF importer acceptance.
Compare documented FreeCAD importer scopes with the separate DXF entity and ACIS carrier families.
Reconcile LibreCAD_3's read-only DWG policy and ACadSharp/dwg-rs support statements with their evidence limits.
Audit existing local CLI and opt-in FreeCAD test owners to avoid duplicate tests or mandatory external dependencies.
Refine PAR-07/S8 artifact and consumer receipts without changing code, fixtures, validation cadence, or support claims.

sources.revision: Mutable main-branch source pages inspected 2026-10-20; no source commit or FreeCAD binary was pinned in this research pass.
sources.observed: convertToDxf invokes the selected converter with Popen/communicate and checks whether the expected DXF path exists before returning it. Its ODA command requests ACAD2000 DXF. convertToDwg invokes the selected LibreDWG/ODA/QCAD helper and returns the requested DWG path without validating the created output in that helper. The module docstring still describes an ODA-only route while the implementation selects among configured converters. The Import.readDXF binding exposes ignore_errors (default true) and option-source arguments for importer-specific validation.
sources.limits: Source inspection does not establish installed FreeCAD behavior on any OS, nor does a helper return prove a file was created, strictly parsed, or semantically imported.

sources.revision: Accessible documentation branch inspected 2026-10-20; the documentation repository's archival status and exact runtime currency are not treated as qualification evidence.
sources.observed: The page describes selectable C++ and legacy Python importers with different entity lists, lists 3DFACE for the legacy route but not C++, and states stock FreeCAD cannot read ACIS/SAT solid blobs in DXF.
sources.limits: These are project documentation statements, not tests against a pinned binary; importer support must be measured per exact application build, backend, and settings.

sources.project: Local FreeCAD-form CLI and installed-app tests
sources.observed: The local command-line harness covers FreeCAD-form argv, conversion status/output/version, self-readback, refusal and atomicity. Separate opt-in installed FreeCAD tests are registered and labelled as integration checks.
sources.limits: The default CLI tests do not execute the FreeCAD Python wrapper or independently establish FreeCAD object/geometry semantics.

sources.revision: Mutable master documentation inspected 2026-10-20; its claim counts refer to that document's pinned libdxfrw revision.
sources.observed: The document says DWG import is optional and read-only, DWG writing is deliberately not implemented/exposed, and write support would require independent downstream evidence. Its described ledger contains read-direction claims only.
sources.limits: Consumer governance is not a DWG writer test or a claim about the current libdxfrw worktree.

sources.revision: Mutable repository README and maintainer discussion inspected 2026-10-20; the cited writer caveat comment is dated 2025-02-16 and is not linked to a release artifact in this pass.
sources.observed: The README advertises DWG writing across several AC codes. The maintainer comment describes R14/R15 output as unstable/recovery-prone, R21 writer as unimplemented at that time, and R18/R27/R32 as the better writer routes then.
sources.limits: The comment is historical and peer-specific; it does not qualify the current release, branch, or a libdxfrw implementation.

sources.revision: Mutable repository README inspected 2026-10-20; its empirical matrix is dated 2026-08-30 and identifies 0.1.0-alpha.1.
sources.observed: The project labels itself pre-alpha, reports per-version decoded/skipped/errored totals across 19 files, has only one AC1032 file in that table, and documents that adding record-boundary validation surfaced errors hidden by earlier unbounded decoders.
sources.limits: Small corpus, pre-alpha status, no DWG writer or native acceptance, and no 3D semantic evidence; metrics are corpus-specific.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: distinguish a converter process result, artifact existence/integrity, strict independent DXF/DWG reopen, downstream consumer import, and geometry semantics as separate evidence fields.
PAR-07/S8: pin FreeCAD build/platform, selected converter and importer/backend/options; classify stock FreeCAD ACIS/SAT support as unsupported rather than as a converter defect.
PAR-07/S8: keep peer capability matrices subordinate to exact artifact, version, operation, corpus denominator, and native acceptance evidence.
Local fast-validation plan: reuse current FreeCAD-form CLI and opt-in integration owners; add no duplicate test, fixture, routine peer run, or full-suite gate.

planChanges: Added a PAR-07/S8 evidence split for converter process status, actual artifact integrity, strict reopen, selected importer, and per-source semantic disposition.
Recorded FreeCAD's ODA-import ACAD2000 DXF target as an explicit downgrade that must be observed and scored against the intended conversion profile.
Clarified that FreeCAD's actual configured converter route must be observed from the pinned application build; its current source helper and module docstring describe different route breadth.
Recorded that FreeCAD converter helper return paths, peer support matrices, and same-codec readback cannot independently qualify output.
Cross-checked existing local FreeCAD-form CLI and opt-in installed-application tests; no duplicate test or routine external validation was added.
Kept FreeCAD ACIS/SAT as an expected unsupported consumer path, LibreCAD_3 as read-only policy, and peer DWG metrics as route/corpus scoped evidence only.
limitations: Research used public source and documentation pages only; no current FreeCAD binary, converter, ACadSharp artifact, or dwg-rs executable was run.
The FreeCAD application pages are mutable main-branch references and must be pinned to a source commit or installed binary at the future composed gate.
FreeCAD documentation and peer maintainer reports are not normative DWG/DXF byte-layout authorities; ODA v5.4.1 and Autodesk DXF references remain controlling for format questions.
No external sample or peer test corpus was downloaded; no repository fixture, finding, implementation blocker, or support claim changed.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
